fields.name: context

fields.name: is_experiment_active

fields.name: key

fields.name: project_id
fields.short: ID of the project this flag belongs to

fields.name: ruleset
fields.short: Complete ruleset for a feature flag including variants and rollout configuration

fields.name: workspace_id
fields.short: ID of the workspace (dataview) this flag belongs to

regionAndDomain.description:
The server location to be used:
* `api.mixpanel` - The default (US) servers used for most projects
* `api-eu.mixpanel` - EU servers if you are enrolled in EU Data Residency
* `api-in.mixpanel` - India servers if you are enrolled in India Data Residency
